_doc: Who voices whom (ElevenLabs voice ids). 'clones' are real people who gave permission (nobody else is ever cloned); 'designed' are custom voices made with ElevenLabs Voice Design (scripts/voice-design.py, descriptions in 'designed_desc') and take priority over 'stock' (older library voices, kept as a fallback). 'hold' = not generated yet (waiting on a clone; their Kreddle doubles wait too). Speakers not listed get a pool voice by a stable hash of their name; 'female' picks the pool. Every line renders on eleven_v3 with delivery tags (docs/VOICE_MOODS.md), except that clones in 'v2_neutral' keep eleven_multilingual_v2 for lines with no mood (they sounded less like themselves on v3). 'delivery' is a speaker's default tag when a line has no other mood.

designed_desc.KRANKY KRANDALL: A reedy, squeaky, frail old British man in his nineties. Thin, high, wavering, slightly wheezy voice, rambling and forgetful, trailing off mid-sentence.

designed_desc.THE CUDDLE CRONSTER: A completely unhinged, gleeful cartoon creature voice, British. Wobbly and gurgling, as if talking through a mouthful of jelly; a big bouncy booming chest voice that suddenly lurches up into a shrill, cracking squeal. Manic, babbling, over-excited and slightly unintelligible, bellowing with delight, then cooing sweetly, then screeching. Totally insane energy.
